faq.q: What is the best time to visit Nrisingha Temple?

faq.a: The nearest airport is Nrisingha Temple / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Howrah Junction (Kolkata) (90 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
